summary: Build valid, reliable assessments with our 5-day test item development course. Master CTT, IRT, blueprinting, and standard setting. Enrol today.
lede: Item development training helps assessment professionals design examinations with a clear blueprint and structured item-review methods. For assessment developers, credentialing managers and instructional designers, it covers writing and reviewing test items, analyzing item performance with Classical Test Theory, and setting cut scores through an Angoff-style process, while introducing IRT concepts for informed item-bank decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who build, manage, commission, or quality-assure assessments in credentialing, corporate learning, academic, or professional certification contexts. It assumes you are already working in an assessment-adjacent role and want to apply a structured psychometric methodology to your current or upcoming projects.
audience: Instructional Designers with responsibility for summative
modules: Test Item Writing: Constructed-Response and Performance Formats
Item Review, Bias Analysis, and Item Banking
Classical Test Theory: Item and Test Analysis
Item Response Theory: Conceptual and Operational Application
Standard Setting and Cut Score Determination
prerequisites: Participants should bring a laptop capable of running spreadsheet software (Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets) for the CTT item analysis exercises. All item response datasets, item writing templates, blueprint worksheets, bias review checklists, and standard-setting simulation materials are provided by the facilitator. No specialist psychometric software licences are required. Participants who wish to explore IRT software independently after the course may download the free version of Xcalibre or use the open-source R package ltm, but neither is required during the course itself.
